messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 — multiple GPU OOMs detected on decode-pool-3 over the last 3 minutes. Auto-page to oncall.
maya (oncall): saw the page, I'm on it :rotating_light:
maya (oncall): @dilip can you pull latest cuda logs from node decode-3? suspect streaming decode runaway.
dilip (runtime): grabbing logs now, will paste tail. looks like a decode loop + unbounded max_tokens from a client route.
dilip (runtime): ```
[2026-03-15T18:07:22Z] cuda: OOM when allocating 274877906944 bytes
[2026-03-15T18:07:22Z] runtime: decode step 4692, tokens generated this request: 1_234_567
[2026-03-15T18:07:23Z] container: process killed with signal 9
[2026-03-15T18:07:23Z] docker: restarting container redwood-decode-3 (image: inference:v2.4.1)
```
maya (oncall): wow, 1.2M tokens/req — confirms runaway. which route is spiking?
dilip (runtime): route: /v1/chat/stream from customer acct: corp-gamma. They recently changed prompt_template in their integration (maybe missing stop tokens). Jordan, can you confirm customer activity?
jordan (support): corp-gamma reporting intermittent 502s since ~18:05 UTC. Support ticket open 10294. They sent LLM prompts programmatically in a loop, might be missing max_tokens override.
eva (sre): I'll cordon decode-3 and drain remaining pods to stop further noisy restarts. On it.
deploy-bot: Initiating container restart: redwood-decode-3 -> restart started (cmd: systemctl restart redwood-decode)
deploy-bot: restart completed, healthcheck OK.
eva (sre): cordon done, moved traffic off decode-3. Scaling up decode-pool by +2 instances as a short-term capacity buffer.
maya (oncall): temporary mitigation — apply per-route max_tokens cap (512) and enable request-level token quota for corp-gamma. @dilip can you push a hotfix to routing config?
dilip (runtime): patch ready: set route override { "max_tokens": 512, "stream_enabled": true, "token_quota": 10000/day } applying now.
dilip (runtime): applied. routing table updated, new requests should be capped at 512 tokens. Also toggled prefix KV caching off for that route to avoid memory spikes.
maya (oncall): good. any immediate errors after patch?
dilip (runtime): seeing drop in OOMs, decode-3 restarts stopped. GPU mem use back to normal on remaining nodes.
jordan (support): notified corp-gamma of temporary caps and recommended they add explicit stop tokens and per-request max_tokens in their client. They accepted and are testing.
eva (sre): will keep decode-3 drained and schedule a forensic capture of container crash dump. created ticket INF-3342.
maya (oncall): customer impact summary: corp-gamma experienced intermittent 502s and dropped streams from ~18:05–18:24 UTC. Other customers unaffected. No PII observed in crash dumps. severity remains SEV2 until followups done.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: root cause suspected: unbounded generation from customer prompts + missing per-route max_tokens leading to CUDA OOM and container crash.
maya (oncall): next steps: 1) keep routing cap for 2h, 2) onboard safety default: set system-wide route-default max_tokens=1024, 3) postmortem assignment to @dilip/@eva, 4) customer follow-up by @jordan.
tay (oncall-next): I'm taking handoff in 20m, will monitor and follow up if anything flares. pls ping if any regression.
maya (oncall): handing off now — logs and actions in the ticket. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
jordan (support): writing customer-facing summary and escalation notes.
dilip (runtime): adding a small alert rule to detect per-request token counts >100k and auto-throttle — PR incoming.
maya (oncall): closing active page; marking incident as mitigated. keep channel for follow-ups and postmortem comments.
